notes: Fixes the root cause of duplicate Attack buttons on canonical firearms such as Lexington and Achilles.

FEHA World Hygiene now removes legacy dnd5e attack pseudo-documents through the official Item5e.deleteActivity API instead of generic object-deletion syntax, which did not reliably mutate dnd5e's ActivitiesField.
Cleanup runs across world weapons and actor-owned copies, deletes each confirmed legacy stub individually, and verifies the deleted activity IDs are actually gone before reporting success.
Ambiguous multiple-real-attack weapons remain untouched and are reported rather than guessed.
Foundry 14.367 malformed-identifier quarantine is preserved. Quarantined items are not database-mutated, while the sheet guard still hides confirmed legacy stubs in rendered item/actor sheets.
Adds a renderApplicationV2 fallback to the legacy-activity UI guard so modern dnd5e sheets are covered as well.
No cyberware work or weapon balance changes are included.
